card.name: Units after a number: mL, miles, mph
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number, mostly mL in mg/mL concentrations, and also miles, hour or mph in speeds. It also fires weakly on 'web' before 'site'.

modes.label: Concentration units
modes.description: The mL part of mg/mL or a volume in mL after a number in dosing or dilution text.

modes.label: Speed units
modes.description: Miles, hour or mph after a speed figure.
